sentences.text: Peti  Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Twinkal Kumari W/O- Ajit Kumar Singh, D/O- Ashutosh Kumar Singh  Resident of Vill- Golma, P.S.- Patharghat, District- Saharsa  ...

... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Dinkar Kumar, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Dr. Kumar Uday Pratap, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KHATIM REZA
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Saharsa Complaint Case No. 326 of 2024,
instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 379, 498(A), 504, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act but learned S.D.J.M. took cognizance under Section 498A IPC and  of the D.P. Act.
3.
The petitioner is the husband of Opposite Party No. 2 and he is ready to keep his wife with full dignity and honour.
Issue notice to Opposite Party No. 2 under Speed Post with A/D as well as through ordinary process for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks.
5. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner.
